d:
Official video for D.C. based singer and songwriter Vidya’s 2015 cover of Taylor Swift's billboard smash hit "Blank Space" and "Mental Manadhil" by A.R. Rahman and Jonita Gandhi, from the movie "OK Kanmani".
Vidya Vox Bookings:
I love me some Tay Tay. She's the bomb and her album, 1989, is so good! I really like the hook from the OK Kanmani song, so I thought they would go well together. Happy listening!

Original song credits:
"Blank Space," Taylor Swift, 1989
"Mental Manadhil," A.R. Rahman, Jonita Gandhi, from the movie "OK Kanmani"
